# Once-per-lobby precompute: computes each qualifying province definition's
# industry coverages definition-wide, stores them on every province slice in
# the definition along with the winning option indices and raw-input presence
# flags the tooltip breakdown chips read, and stores each location's best
# right index as a location variable, so the map mode and tooltip only read
# stored values. Variables stored on the province_definition itself do not
# read back, so everything is staged in locals and written to every slice.

				remove_variable = cm_trmm_in_wool
			}
			# Best right per location, encoded as round(score * 1000) * 10 + index so
			# the chained min = (raise-to-at-least) running maximum keeps both the score
			# and which right holds it. Higher index wins score ties, so index order is
			# the reverse of the priority order.
			every_location_in_province = {
				set_local_variable = {
					name = cm_trmm_enc
					value = {
						value = 0
						min = cm_trmm_enc_tooling
						min = cm_trmm_enc_jewelry
						min = cm_trmm_enc_naval
						min = cm_trmm_enc_textile
						min = cm_trmm_enc_weaponry
						min = cm_trmm_enc_book
						min = cm_trmm_enc_artisan
						min = cm_trmm_enc_brewing
						min = cm_trmm_enc_masonry
					}
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = cm_trmm_best_idx
					value = {
						value = local_var:cm_trmm_enc
						modulo = 10
					}
				}
				# Tie data for the stripes: 0 = no tie, 1-8 = the runner-up right of a
				# two-way tie for best, 10 = three or more tied. An exact-tied earlier
				# right would have won the encoding, so only later rights can be partners.
				set_variable = {
					name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
					value = 0
				}
				if = {
					# enc below 10 = best score rounds to 0.
					limit = { local_var:cm_trmm_enc >= 10 }
					if = {
						limit = { var:cm_trmm_best_idx = 9 }
						if = {
							limit = { cm_trmm_tie_count_tooling >= 2 }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 10
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { cm_trmm_diff_tooling__jewelry = 0 }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 8
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { cm_trmm_diff_tooling__naval = 0 }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 7
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { cm_trmm_diff_tooling__textile = 0 }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 6
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { cm_trmm_diff_tooling__weaponry = 0 }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 5
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { cm_trmm_diff_tooling__book = 0 }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 4
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { cm_trmm_diff_tooling__artisan = 0 }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 3
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { cm_trmm_diff_tooling__brewing = 0 }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 2
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { cm_trmm_diff_tooling__masonry = 0 }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 1
							}
						}
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { var:cm_trmm_best_idx = 8 }
						if = {
							limit = { cm_trmm_tie_count_jewelry >= 2 }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 10
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { cm_trmm_diff_jewelry__naval = 0 }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 7
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { cm_trmm_diff_jewelry__textile = 0 }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 6
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { cm_trmm_diff_jewelry__weaponry = 0 }

								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx

							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 1
							}
						}
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { var:cm_trmm_best_idx = 7 }
						if = {
							limit = { cm_trmm_tie_count_naval >= 2 }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 10
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { cm_trmm_diff_naval__textile = 0 }

							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 1
							}

					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { var:cm_trmm_best_idx = 6 }
						if = {
							limit = { cm_trmm_tie_count_textile >= 2 }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 10
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { cm_trmm_diff_textile__weaponry = 0 }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 5

						}
						else_if = {

							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx

						else_if = {

							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 3
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { cm_trmm_diff_textile__brewing = 0 }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 2
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { cm_trmm_diff_textile__masonry = 0 }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 1
							}
						}
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { var:cm_trmm_best_idx = 5 }
						if = {
							limit = { cm_trmm_tie_count_weaponry >= 2 }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 10
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { cm_trmm_diff_weaponry__book = 0 }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 4
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { cm_trmm_diff_weaponry__artisan = 0 }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 3
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { cm_trmm_diff_weaponry__brewing = 0 }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 2
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { cm_trmm_diff_weaponry__masonry = 0 }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 1
							}
						}
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { var:cm_trmm_best_idx = 4 }
						if = {
							limit = { cm_trmm_tie_count_book >= 2 }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 10
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { cm_trmm_diff_book__artisan = 0 }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 3
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { cm_trmm_diff_book__brewing = 0 }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 2
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { cm_trmm_diff_book__masonry = 0 }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 1
							}
						}
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { var:cm_trmm_best_idx = 3 }
						if = {
							limit = { cm_trmm_tie_count_artisan >= 2 }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 10
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { cm_trmm_diff_artisan__brewing = 0 }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 2
							}
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { cm_trmm_diff_artisan__masonry = 0 }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 1
							}
						}
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { var:cm_trmm_best_idx = 2 }
						if = {
							limit = { cm_trmm_diff_brewing__masonry = 0 }
							set_variable = {
								name = cm_trmm_tie_idx
								value = 1
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		every_province_in_province_definition = {
			every_location_in_province = {
				limit = { has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx }
				remove_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx
			}
			every_location_in_province = {
				limit = { has_variable = cm_trmm_tie_idx }
				remove_variable = cm_trmm_tie_idx
			}
		}
	}
}

cm_trmm_recompute_all = {
	every_province_definition = {
		cm_trmm_recompute_province_definition = yes
	}
}
